pairs.evidence: app/features/hiring/schedule/useScheduleInterviewPrep.ts:125 Every edit cancels the pending 600 ms progress save without a maximum-wait deadline, so continuous editing can postpone persistence indefinitely while the modal remains mounted.

techniques.evidence: app/features/hiring/schedule/useScheduleInterviewPrep.ts:125 The effect restarts on checked, notes, interviewer and prep changes, with no maximum wait; the unmount flush does not bound postponement while mounted.

app/features/hiring/schedule/useScheduleInterviewPrep.ts:108 The debounced save discards HTTP responses and catches network failures without recording or displaying an outcome, leaving failed saves silent.
